_about: Fixed views for trailer-ready screenshots (tools/showcase.py, README.md, Showcase). Each view is a name and the command-line args of one run (AGENTS.md, Screenshot: the flags). The runner renders every view with --write-movie and keeps its last frame, so the same set can be shot before and after each step and compared. Names are unique and use a-z, 0-9 and _. tests/test_showcase.gd checks that every map, spawn, festival and lens named here exists.
